meta.name: give-me-tips
meta.description: Explains any senpi tip in depth - startup tips, working tips, and any Tip: line shown in the TUI (including the Fable-5-refusal fallback tip). Use when the user asks about a Tip: line, says give-me-tips, asks what a tip means, how a tipped feature works, or which tips they can see. Queries the live tip list (senpi --list-tips) first, checks what THIS user can actually see, then verifies the real feature code before explaining.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 深入解释任何senpi提示的含义与用法
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果使用senpi时想弄懂每条提示在说什么
copy.tagline_en: Explain any senpi tip in depth
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to understand what each senpi tip means and how to use it

howto.what: 当你问起界面上的某个提示(Tip)时,Claude会先查它的真实来源,确认你本人能看到哪些提示,再核对实现代码并引用文件路径,最后用你的语言讲清含义和原理。
howto.when: 当你说“give-me-tips”,或询问屏幕上的Tip行、某个提示的含义或功能等时触发。

say.text: 刚才屏幕上那行 Tip 是什么意思?
say.note: Claude会去查这个提示的详细信息并解释。
直接触发技能,解释你看到的提示。

say.text: 我目前能看到哪些提示?
say.note: Claude会检查你的设置并列出你实际可见的提示。

howto.what_en: When you ask about a Tip line, Claude fetches the live tip list, checks which tips you personally can see, then verifies the code (citing file paths) and explains the tip's meaning and mechanics in your language.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say 'give-me-tips', ask about a Tip line on screen, or question the meaning or behavior of a tip, etc.

say_en.text: What does that Tip line on screen mean?
say_en.note: Claude will look it up and explain it.
Triggers the skill to explain the tip you saw.

say_en.text: Which tips can I actually see?
say_en.note: Claude checks your settings and lists the tips you can see.
